review_notes: I read the whole file. I compared the two quantile lemmas (`midpoint_quantile_substitution`, `midpoint_quantile_defect_lower`) with sibling files (WeightedPrekopa.lean, DisplacementInequality.lean), and checked the quantile and velocity continuity API in InteriorQuantile.lean and FacetQuantile.lean. The AM-GM lemmas, `integral_sq_ge_sq_integral` and the velocity-square integrability lemma are each used once and share no non-trivial reasoning with each other. The only repeated machinery I found is the interval-localisation scaffold for quantiles on [l,r] ⊂ (0,1). It is mostly routine, so this is a modest finding. I did not check that the proposed helpers compile. `quantile_continuousAt` has the same hypotheses in InteriorQuantile.lean and in the target's uses, so the helper would sit after InteriorQuantile and need no new imports.

findings.problem: Both quantile lemmas rebuild the same localisation scaffold for [l,r] ⊂ (0,1). First, `hsub : uIcc l r ⊆ Ioo 0 1` is proved with identical lines. Then each lemma re-derives `ContinuousAt` of `quantile f a b` and `quantile g c d` on the interval from `quantile_continuousAt` via `hsub`, and re-extracts `hp' : p ∈ Ioo 0 1 := hsub (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hp)`. The same text appears in WeightedPrekopa.lean (`weighted_quantile_substitution`, `weighted_quantile_integral_lower`) and DisplacementInequality.lean. Four or more copies of the scaffold in the library means any change to the quantile API has to be repeated in each.
findings.proposed_change:
Add two small shared lemmas after `quantile_continuousAt` in InteriorQuantile.lean:
(1) `uIcc_subset_Ioo_zero_one {l r : ℝ} (hl : 0 < l) (hr : r < 1) (hlr : l ≤ r) : uIcc l r ⊆ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1`. Proof: `rw [uIcc_of_le hlr]; intro p hp; exact ⟨hl.trans_le hp.1, hp.2.trans_lt hr⟩`.
(2) `quantile_continuousOn_subset {f a b s} (hf : IntervalDensity f a b) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, 0 < f x) (hab : a < b) (hs : s ⊆ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) : ContinuousOn (quantile f a b) s`. Proof: `fun p hp => (quantile_continuousAt hf hpos hab (hs hp)).continuousWithinAt`.
In `midpoint_quantile_substitution`, replace `hsub` with `uIcc_subset_Ioo_zero_one hl hr hlr` and the first bullet with `((quantile_continuousOn_subset hf hfpos hab hsub).add (quantile_continuousOn_subset hg hgpos hcd hsub)).div_const 2 p hp`. In `midpoint_quantile_defect_lower`, `hcqf` and `hcqg` become `quantile_continuousOn_subset ...`, and `hsub` comes from the same lemma. The same helpers then serve the WeightedPrekopa and DisplacementInequality copies.
findings.benefit: The repeated setup becomes named lemmas. Each transport proof then starts from the mathematically relevant steps, which are the change of variables and the AM-GM comparison. A future change to the quantile continuity API is made in one place instead of at least four.
